sentences.en: Which team is the most likely to win the championship?

sentences.en: The player won the championship three times in a row.
sentences.zh: 这位选手连续三次赢得了冠军。

sentences.en: They will be fighting for the championship this time tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他们明天将为争夺冠军而战。
